review.rapid7.rapid7.insightvm.is.a.mode: Rapid7 InsightVM is a modern vulnerability management solution that goes beyond simple scanning to provide real risk prioritization based on exploit availability, malware exposure, and business context.
review.rapid7.the.platform.offers.live.d: The platform offers live dashboards that show vulnerability status in real-time, enabling security teams to track remediation progress and demonstrate risk reduction to stakeholders. Integration with IT operations tools streamlines the remediation workflow.
review.rapid7.insightvm.is.part.of.rapid: InsightVM is part of Rapid7's Insight platform, which includes SIEM (InsightIDR), application security (InsightAppSec), and cloud security capabilities for comprehensive security operations.
Risk prioritization based on exploitability, exposure, and business criticality.
Real-time visibility into vulnerability status and remediation progress.
review.rapid7.assign.and.track.remediati: Assign and track remediation tasks with IT operations integration.
review.rapid7.flexible.scanning.with.lig: Flexible scanning with lightweight agents or network-based discovery.
review.rapid7.scan.aws.azure.gcp.resourc: Scan AWS, Azure, GCP resources and container environments.
review.rapid7.built-in.policy.checks.for: Built-in policy checks for PCI, HIPAA, CIS benchmarks, and more.
review.rapid7.enterprise.pricing.based.o: Enterprise pricing based on deployment scale and features:
review.rapid7.custom.pricing.based.on.or: Custom pricing based on organization size
review.rapid7.rapid7.offers.free.product: Rapid7 offers FREE product certifications for InsightVM (vulnerability management) and InsightIDR (detection and response). These credentials validate hands-on skills with Rapid7's security analytics platform.
review.rapid7.deploy.and.manage.insightv: Deploy and manage InsightVM for vulnerability assessment, asset discovery, and risk-based prioritization.
review.rapid7.configure.insightidr.for.s: Configure InsightIDR for SIEM, user behavior analytics (UBA), and incident detection and response (IDR).
